thread:
sasha: Heads-up — Sirocco private VPC deploy tonight. Window 00:30–01:30 UTC. Customer-facing cutover at 00:45. Who can lead the deploy and own rollback if we need it?

kevin: I can lead (on-call able to assist). I’ll be on from 00:20 to 02:00 UTC.

maria: I’ll do smoke tests + post-cutover checks. Plan to run the usual health script and run a small sample inference.

jamal: Quick Q — is there any DB migration in this change? I thought Sirocco asked for a metadata index update.

sasha: No DB migrations this window. Only model push + routing changes in the private control plane. Metadata index update was postponed to next week.

kevin: TL;DR deploy plan: 1) Pause customer traffic (route to read-only) 2) Push model v1.2.3 to private cluster 3) Warm caches / run KV prewarm 4) Switch route and run smoke. If rollback: re-pin to v1.2.2 and restore routing.

maria: Smoke checklist I’ll run after switch (and share results):
- /health endpoints across 3 zones
- sample generation: curl -s -X POST "https://sirocco.example.internal/v1/generate" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":8}' | jq .output
- embed sanity: run a quick embed vector on a known input, compare cosine >= 0.85
- tail logs for errors (5m window)

kevin: I’ll toggle the routing with the canary policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 10m, unless major errors. If anything >= 5% 5xx or latency > 2s p50 we stop and roll back.

jamal: What about KV cache warm? Do we have the prewarm job ready?

kevin: Yes — I pushed a branch with the prewarm job. Command on the control plane node: 
```
./prewarm_kv.sh --model v1.2.3 --clients 50 --duration 300
```
It hits the private VPC endpoints and populates the KV store.

sasha: Also: make sure ops-alerting is unmuted for this window. Pointing to: #eng-oncall and pager duty escalation. If we rollback, update the ticket and ping @mira (SRE lead) to re-run chaos checks tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy slot created: Sirocco_Private_2027-02-10_0030_UTC by sasha. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sirocco-private-deploy. Reminder 10m before window.

maria: One more: I’ll run the end-to-end prompt set (5 prompts) and post latency + token counts in the thread. If quality regression > 3/5 prompts flagged then we rollback.

kevin: Ack. I’ll post a short postmortem template in thread after the window. Anyone not available?

jamal: I’ll be on standby for rollback verification. Have the tag for v1.2.2 ready locally.

sasha: Great — thanks. Final checklist before I close: @kevin confirm deploy lead, @maria confirm smoke ownership, @jamal rollback standby, ops-alerts unmuted. Reply with :thumbsup: if good.

maria: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

jamal: :thumbsup:

sasha: Closing the loop — I’ll post a 10m reminder and then the go/no-go at T-5. Good luck team!
